items.title: Is Starbucks (SBUX) Reasonable After Its 14% Run And Margin Pressure?
items.summary: Starbucks shares have quietly delivered a 14.1% gain over the past year, even as recent weeks have been choppier. This puts a fresh spotlight on whether the current valuation still lines up with the cash the business can generate over time. Over the last 12 months, Starbucks has delivered a 14.1% share price return, so anyone looking at the stock today is effectively asking whether that move already reflects its underlying cash flows. items.title: Starbucks Plans Global Capability Centre in India, Reuters Reports
items.summary: Starbucks (NASDAQ:SBUX) is planning to establish a global capability centre in Chennai, India, with approximately 800 jobs expected to be created during the project’s initial phase, Reuters reported on Monday. The news agency cited a government source familiar with the plans.
